description: Light, sturdy, and quietly stylish — this cotton canvas tote slides into everyday life and holds up to the rhythm of a busy day. The heavyweight 12 oz canvas feels substantial in your hands and stands open for easy loading. Flat corners keep the profile clean so groceries, market finds, or a small stack of books sit neatly without bulging. Reinforced self-fabric handles carry the weight where it counts, and the sewn-in label is a subtle reminder of honest construction. Choose natural or black to match your mood; either way the bag wears a calm, lived-in look that pairs with casual commutes, farmers’ market mornings, or last-minute errands. Product features - 100% heavyweight cotton canvas (12 oz/yd²) for durability - Flat-corner construction for a neat, compact shape - Self-fabric carrying handles with reinforced stitching - Sewn-in label and sourced blank product (India) - Available in natural and black colors Care instructions - Do not iron directly over the printed area - print may stick to the iron. - Spot clean - Do not bleach - Line dry
